purpose: Executable ledger for the `contrast-update-prior` route-support family; normalized schema envelope added in rev0293.
non_promotion_rule: A contrast class can lower, block, or localize support. It does not promote a route; it prevents evidence from being spent without a declared rival set, quotient policy, and completeness status.

contrast_rows.target_question: Does the record distinguish a native bulk/code target from dual descriptions, simulator leakage, or code-space priors?
live_alternatives: dual holographic presentation with same boundary records
code-space overfit or learned inverse surrogate
contrast_rows.null_or_decoy_family: dual holographic presentation with same boundary records
contrast_rows.quotient_policy: only quotient-declared partial identity may be spent; same public record under a dual dictionary is not a different candidate by default

contrast_rows.target_question: Does the derivation identify microscopic ontology or only recover effective equations under thermodynamic assumptions?
live_alternatives: hydrodynamic/effective coarse-graining with no native witness
contrast_rows.quotient_policy: effective-equation agreement is not candidate identity; confirmation cannot transfer from recovered GR-form equations to microscopic ontology without a transfer rule

contrast_rows.comparator_scope: string/M atlas, compactification, duality, and vacuum selection
contrast_rows.target_question: Does the record select a candidate or merely navigate a landscape / duality presentation / post-hoc vacuum?
contrast_rows.quotient_policy: candidate identity must be quotient-aware across dualities and must not treat one vacuum selection as global ToE selection

contrast_rows.target_question: Does the evidence survive regulator/truncation changes as a physical fixed point rather than an artifact?
live_alternatives: finite-basis projection with no observed-sector inverse
contrast_rows.quotient_policy: only truncation-portable, regulator-stress-tested features may spend support; candidate identity is not inherited from a fixed-point-looking projection

contrast_rows.target_question: Does the route distinguish a native causal-set dynamics from continuum-mimic simulations or discretization artifacts?
contrast_rows.quotient_policy: continuum recovery and native dynamics must be separated; a simulator target cannot become candidate identity

contrast_rows.target_question: Does consistency, positivity, or S-matrix reconstruction select an ontology or only constrain allowed completions?
live_alternatives: EFT coefficient fit with many completions
contrast_rows.quotient_policy: on-shell consistency support cannot be transferred to off-shell ontology or ToE identity without an explicit translation / contrast rule

contrast_rows.comparator_scope: low-energy laboratory mediator quantumness and gravitational interaction records
contrast_rows.target_question: Does the lab record distinguish quantum gravitational mediation or statistics from classical-hybrid, source-state, subsystem, or detector confounds?
contrast_rows.quotient_policy: lab routes may earn discriminator-class credit but not full candidate identity; contrast is mediator/class level unless a candidate-native inverse is declared

contrast_rows.target_question: Does the strain/catalog record distinguish a ToE candidate or only test GR consistency / modified-gravity alternatives?
contrast_rows.quotient_policy: absence/presence of deviations constrains classes but does not identify a complete ontology without a candidate-native record map

contrast_rows.quotient_policy: records count as shared only after an explicit frame/gauge transport equivalence; no same/different candidate claim by coordinate label alone

contrast_rows.target_question: Does a trigger/statistics record distinguish graviton-counting physics from source-state, detector, or correlated-noise ambiguity?
contrast_rows.quotient_policy: counting/statistics support is a physical discriminator only after source-state and detector priors are stress-tested

contrast_rows.comparator_scope: late-time dark-energy model comparison and survey likelihoods

contrast_rows.quotient_policy: cosmological model-comparison pressure remains prior- and nuisance-sensitive; a likelihood shift is not a ToE selector

contrast_rows.comparator_scope: primordial tensor / B-mode detection or bound
contrast_rows.target_question: Does a tensor/B-mode record distinguish early-universe quantum-gravity candidates or only constrain many inflationary / reheating / foreground alternatives?
contrast_rows.quotient_policy: B-mode evidence must be contrastive across foreground, delensing, reheating, and mechanism alternatives before candidate-level support is spent

contrast_rows.comparator_scope: metadata / provenance wrapper versus physical support
contrast_rows.target_question: Does a public metadata or provenance wrapper improve custody without being counted as an independent physical evidence line?
contrast_rows.quotient_policy: metadata/provenance improves custody and replay but never counts as a physical contrast class or independent confirmation by itself
